case_name: Smt Poornima W/O Shashikantesh vs Sri Shashikantesh S/O Kashinath — full case name
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of M.C.No.56/2023 from Principal Judge, Family Court, Dharwad to Principal Judge, Family Court, Koppal due to difference of opinion and neglect by respondent-husband.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a petition to establish that the transfer is necessary in the interest of justice and equity.
legal_principles.held: Having heard the arguments and perusing the records, it is evident that the relationship between the parties is undisputed.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking maintenance must establish that they have no means to support themselves.
legal_principles.held: She asserts she is not in a position to travel from Koppal to Dharwad and hence, she would seek for transfer of the petition filed by the respondent-husband from the Principal Family Court, Dhaward to the Principal Family Court, Koppal.

outcome.final_order: Petition is allowed. The petition filed by the respondent-husband from the Principal Family Court, Dharwad to the Principal Family Court, Koppal is transferred.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition under Section 24 CPC
